clauses.text: An actual distance up to and including 15% above the optimal distance is a reasonable detour; no refund.
The part above 15% is refunded at per_km_rate: refund = max(0, actual_km - optimal_km*(1+15%)) * per_km_rate.
If third-party traffic data shows the detour saved time because of heavy congestion (actual_duration <= optimal_duration_with_traffic), it is treated as justified and refund = 0.

refund_formula: overcharged_km = max(0, actual_km - optimal_km*(1+max_tolerated_deviation_pct/100)); if traffic_justified(actual_duration <= optimal_est_duration_with_traffic): refund=0 else refund = overcharged_km * per_km_rate
